title: The two great dangers: dividing and squaring

board_content.text: If you cancel $\cos\theta$ from $\sin\theta\cos\theta=\cos\theta$, you silently throw away every solution where $\cos\theta=0$.
Cancelling assumes the thing you cancel is non-zero — but here it can be zero. Factor, never divide.
Squaring both sides can make a false equation look true, since $(-1)^2=1^2$.

board_content.latex: \sin x + \cos x = 1 \xrightarrow{\text{square}} \sin 2x = 0,\ \text{but } x=\pi \text{ fails the original}

board_content.text: Every solution from a squared equation must be checked back in the original.
These two are the signature traps — both are conceptual gaps, not careless slips.

segments_english.text: Two dangers cause almost every wrong answer in this subtopic, and both are conceptual.
The first is losing roots by dividing. Suppose you have sine theta cosine theta equals cosine theta, and you cancel cosine theta from both sides.
The moment you cancel, you silently throw away every solution where cosine theta is zero.
Cancelling secretly assumes the thing you cancel is non-zero. But here it can be zero, that's exactly the case you just deleted. So factor, and set each factor to zero, never divide.
The second danger is gaining roots by squaring. Squaring both sides can make a false statement look true, because minus one squared equals one squared.

Watch: sine x plus cosine x equals one. Square it and you get sine two x equals zero, which includes x equal to pi. But sine pi plus cosine pi is minus one, not one, so x equal to pi is a fake, an extraneous root.
So every candidate that comes out of a squared equation must be checked back in the original, and the fakes discarded.
These are the two signature traps of the whole subtopic, and notice, they're gaps in understanding, not careless arithmetic.

segments_hinglish.text: दो dangers इस subtopic के लगभग हर ग़लत answer की वजह हैं, और दोनों conceptual हैं.
पहला है divide करके roots खोना. मान लीजिए sine theta cosine theta equals cosine theta है, और आप दोनों तरफ़ से cosine theta cancel कर देते हैं.
जिस पल आप cancel करते हैं, आप चुपचाप हर वो solution फेंक देते हैं जहाँ cosine theta zero है.
Cancel करना चुपके से मानता है कि जो cancel कर रहे हैं वो non-zero है. पर यहाँ वो zero हो सकता है, यही case आपने अभी delete किया. So factor कीजिए, हर factor को zero रखिए, divide कभी नहीं.
दूसरा danger है square करके roots पाना. दोनों तरफ़ square करना झूठे statement को सच दिखा सकता है, क्योंकि minus one squared equals one squared.

देखिए: sine x plus cosine x equals one. Square कीजिए और मिलता है sine two x equals zero, जिसमें x equal to pi शामिल है. पर sine pi plus cosine pi है minus one, one नहीं, so x equal to pi नक़ली है, extraneous root.
So squared equation से निकला हर candidate original में check होना चाहिए, और नक़ली हटा दीजिए.
ये पूरे subtopic के दो signature traps हैं, और ध्यान दीजिए, ये समझ की कमी हैं, careless arithmetic नहीं.
